intent: Every script installed to /usr/local/bin is a tracked repo file: sync-dot-cert.sh is installed from linux_configuration/scripts/ instead of being generated from a heredoc.
scope: Non-goal: stunnel config and units stay generated; deluge-fix-lt.py is not in this commit (repo lint blocks a verbatim copy)
changes: scripts/sync-dot-cert.sh takes <domain> <caddy-container> <cert-dir> (defaults = the installer's) instead of baking them in; install_cert_sync does sudo install -m 755 of it and dies if it is missing
dot-cert-sync.service ExecStart and the installer's first sync pass the three arguments, so a non-default --domain reaches the timer; unused cert_source_dir removed

verification.evidence: no case errors; a mutated sync script (reload removed) makes the jail fail

verification.command: vmbox guest cco: install_cert_sync + install_units as root over a stale generated copy, then the installed script against a docker shim
verification.evidence: installed == tracked (cmp), 755 root, ExecStart passes domain/container/dir, docker cp paths identical to the live script, second run silent. Passed in vmbox, not verified on the host

verification.command: shellcheck -x on the four shell files

risks: The live /usr/local/bin/sync-dot-cert.sh and dot-cert-sync.service stay the old generated ones until setup_dot_resolver.sh is re-run
A bare manual sync-dot-cert.sh run uses the defaults, which must track the installer's constants
rollback: git revert the commit and re-run setup_dot_resolver.sh
Check systemctl start dot-cert-sync.service and setup_dot_resolver.sh --check
